figures.name: unrouted_label_value_leaf_parts

figures.name: statements_status_differing

figures.name: routed_records_answered_null_hash

figures.name: unrouted_cold_records
figures.basis: predicted: no corpus entry of class long_range or mb_full_range_avg_over_time is declared for ci, so stage1.unrouted_cold says not applicable and its count is 0 of 0; on a profile that selects cold entries the band is at least entries x 5 repetitions, and a cold stamp that failed or is absent leaves no count, which fails as missing

figures.name: unrouted_cold_records_short
figures.basis: predicted: every selected cold entry x repetition has a record with a ravel_cost (0 selected on ci)

figures.name: routed_cold_records
figures.basis: predicted: no corpus entry of class long_range or mb_full_range_avg_over_time is declared for ci, so stage1.routed_cold says not applicable and its count is 0 of 0; on a profile that selects cold entries the band is at least entries x 5 repetitions, and a cold stamp that failed or is absent leaves no count, which fails as missing

figures.name: routed_cold_records_short
figures.basis: predicted: every selected cold entry x repetition has a record with a ravel_cost (0 selected on ci)

figures.name: holders_objects_above_watermark
figures.basis: predicted: the fold step ran with --writers-stopped after the last write, so every listed object's ingest hour is at or below the folded watermark

figures.name: holders_window_mismatches
figures.basis: predicted: every unrouted record's segmentsFetched equals its statement's unrouted_fetched_expected, the resolved set plus token_only_fetched: the resolved set is named_in_window (the objects in the window holding a series of the statement's one metric, since the unrouted resolve prunes by that name's postings) when every selector names one metric and segments_in_window (every object in the window) when they name different metrics; token_only_fetched is the listed L0 objects outside that set named by a min_commit_token the query lane passed (one per shard), which the resolve adds whatever their metrics and event time. Run 42495422937 gave 1 here with the token objects left out: mb_absent_selective_labels expected 0 and fetched its 4 shards' token objects

figures.name: holders_window_unchecked
figures.basis: predicted: every counted statement has unrouted records, each with a whole-number segmentsFetched, and a whole-number unrouted_fetched_expected (every min_commit_token the query lane passed names a listed object)

figures.name: holders_routed_prune_mismatches
figures.basis: predicted: for each route_bound statement, every routed record's segmentsPrunedByLabelIndex equals expected_routed_prunes, the resolved set (named_in_window for one metric, segments_in_window for several) less value_holders, the objects of that set whose LABEL_DICT holds, for at least one selector, its metric name and every label="value" value; the router keeps the rest, and objects only a min_commit_token adds are never routed. Run 42495422937 would give 0: every ci object's LABEL_DICT holds every probed value, so value_holders equals named_in_window and the expected and observed prunes are both 0. This replaces routed_records_pruned_by_label_index at least 1, which that run failed with 0 because nothing on ci can be pruned

figures.name: holders_routed_prune_unchecked
figures.basis: predicted: every route_bound statement has routed records, each with a whole-number segmentsPrunedByLabelIndex, and a whole-number expected_routed_prunes

figures.name: holders_routed_leaf_unread
figures.basis: predicted: every routed record of a route_bound statement whose resolved set holds an object shows a leaf read in its keyIndex phase (s3GetRequests or cacheHits above 0), so a prune count of 0 means the router read the leaves and kept every object, not that it never ran; a statement whose resolved set is empty is not counted (its snapshot holds only token objects, which carry no leaf). Run 42495422937 would give 0: its routed keyIndex phases showed cacheHits of 10 and 4 with no GET

figures.name: holders_selective_job_rate_sum
figures.basis: predicted: job="metricsbench-api" series are written on every ci run, so at least one data object holds a series matching the statement's one selector in full (holders is a series-level index's bound; the router's is value_holders, checked through holders_routed_prune_mismatches)
